v4.6.106 — Server-reachability indicator in the header

🟢 A new indicator in the top bar shows whether the app can reach the APEX cloud: green '● server' = reachable, red '● offline' = can't reach it (usually your network). So when something hiccups you can instantly tell a network blip apart from a real app problem — and your cloud bots keep trading on Oracle either way.

Update via the in-app banner.
